labeling_notes: Each malicious sample is one attack structure from a Moltbook family the 2026-11-21 ideas target. The paired sample is the honest version of the same job: the user names the destination or the resource, the scope matches the request, a pin or a yes is required, and the reply lists the change. Labels are assigned by construction of the generator, not by a model. Wording, domain, prose-versus-steps, and single-versus-sidecar layout vary. Multi-file samples put one leg in SKILL.md and the other in a named file under notes/, references/, or config/. Do not tune on the held-out split.
